content.short: SmartCredit.io offers fixed-interest-rate and fixed-term loans for borrowers and provides the Positions Management System; lenders can create fixed-income funds and mix maturities.
content.description: SmartCredit.io offers borrowers predictable financing through fixed-interest-rate and fixed-term borrowing, so they know the cost of capital upfront. Borrowers can use the Positions Management System to monitor their positions, including liquidation risk increases, payment deadlines, and rewards received. For lenders, the platform supports the creation of fixed-income funds, the ability to mix different maturities, and the construction of optimized portfolios.
